title: Define toolset and architecture in CMakePresets.json for VS to avoid mismatches
body:
Changelog: Bugfix: Add ``architecture`` to ``CMakePresets`` to avoid cmake ignoring toolchain definitions when using presets.
Docs: Omit

This doesn't have explicit docs, UI should be the same, just avoiding an error

Close https://github.com/conan-io/conan/issues/13792
